manifest.name: Chinook
manifest.description: A digital music store database for learning SQL, joins, and data tooling.

source.notes: The checked-in SQLite fixture is byte-for-byte the upstream SQLite file from the pinned revision.

tableDescriptions.Artist: Artists represented in the music catalogue.
tableDescriptions.Track: Individual audio tracks available in the store.
tableDescriptions.MediaType: File and encoding types used by tracks.
tableDescriptions.PlaylistTrack: The many-to-many link between playlists and tracks.
tableDescriptions.Customer: Customers who purchase music from the store.
tableDescriptions.Employee: Store employees and their reporting relationships.
tableDescriptions.Invoice: Billing invoices issued to customers for music purchases.
tableDescriptions.InvoiceLine: Individual tracks and quantities on an invoice.

queries.title: Artists by track count
queries.sql: SELECT Artist.Name, COUNT(Track.TrackId) AS Tracks FROM Artist JOIN Album USING (ArtistId) JOIN Track USING (AlbumId) GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId ORDER BY Tracks DESC LIMIT 10;

queries.title: Sales by billing country
queries.sql: SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS Sales FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY Sales DESC LIMIT 10;
